name: Mercenary Throwing Knives
notes: HoH1 Mercenary version of Throwing Knives (players/thief/mercenary/throwing_knives_merc.sval, 14 skill points in the Mercenary skill shop). Against HoH1 level 6 (in brackets): cooldown 0.25 s (0.2 s); mana 25 (20). Its own mana 25 (20), cooldown 0.25 s (0.2 s). Mercenaries bought one fixed version of a class's skill once that class reached level 20 in town; its 'Primary Attack' wording let the class passives work with any weapon. Numbers are HoH1's, not this port's.
summary: Throwing Knives as at level 6 (10 knives, 32 physical, pierce 10) on a 0.25 s cooldown for 25 mana.
